description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the TimerSchedulerServiceImpl class, which manages scheduled tasks using Java's Timer and TimerTask. It handles starting, stopping, rescheduling, and persistence of scheduled tasks within the OpenMRS framework. It also interacts with DAO for database operations and integrates with the Spring framework for transaction management.

classes.name: TimerSchedulerServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a scheduler service that manages tasks using Java's Timer. Handles scheduling, rescheduling, shutdown, persistence, and retrieval of task definitions within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: onStartup
methods.description: Initializes scheduler by loading tasks from database and scheduling those marked to start on startup.

methods.name: onShutdown
methods.description: Graceful shutdown of all scheduled tasks and timers.

methods.name: scheduleTask
methods.description: Schedules a task based on its definition, creating timers and task instances.

methods.name: shutdownTask
methods.description: Stops a running task and updates its status.

methods.name: rescheduleTask
methods.description: Reschedules an existing task by stopping it and scheduling anew.

methods.name: saveTaskDefinition
methods.description: Saves or updates task definition in the database.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes task definition from the database after ensuring it is not running.

methods.name: getScheduledTasks
methods.description: Returns a collection of all tasks currently scheduled.

methods.name: getRegisteredTasks
methods.description: Retrieves all task definitions registered in the system.

methods.name: getTask
methods.description: Fetches task definition by ID.

methods.name: getTaskByName
methods.description: Fetches task definition by its name.

methods.name: getTaskByUuid
methods.description: Fetches task definition by UUID.

methods.name: saveToMemento
methods.description: Saves current task state to an OpenmrsMemento for later restoration.

methods.name: restoreFromMemento
methods.description: Restores task states from a given memento, attempting to restart tasks.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Provides status message of a scheduled task.

methods.name: scheduleIfNotRunning
methods.description: Schedules a task only if it is not already running.

methods.name: rescheduleAllTasks
methods.description: Reschedules all tasks that are currently scheduled.

methods.name: registerTask
methods.description: Adds a TaskDefinition to the registered tasks set.

methods.name: cancelAllTimers
methods.description: Cancels all timers to stop scheduled tasks.

methods.name: shutdownAllTasks
methods.description: Stops all active tasks and cleans up resources.

methods.name: getTimer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Timer for a given TaskDefinition.
